actors.name: Marine Le Pen
actors.role: Candidate for President of France and RN leader
actors.blurb: Le Pen is driving heavy coverage in France following police raids at the home and office of her former chief of staff over suspected leaks. She has sparked wider political backlash by attacking media coverage and threatening to restrict investigative journalism, while continuing to present platform proposals for her 2027 presidential bid.

actors.name: Giorgia Meloni
actors.blurb: Meloni is central to European news cycles following a tense telephone exchange with Volodymyr Zelensky over an uncoordinated Ukrainian strike on Russian assets off the Libyan coast. Domestically, she faces ongoing debate surrounding pension reform and public sector pay, while rejecting proposed EU budget cuts to agriculture.

actors.name: Javier Milei
actors.blurb: Milei secured a key legislative victory as the Senate approved his proposal to suspend mandatory primary elections (PASO). Meanwhile, he is launching a series of books on his administration's ethics, managing diplomatic friction after Brazil excluded him from Lula's inauguration guest list, and defending his economic reform package.

actors.name: Péter Magyar
actors.blurb: Magyar continues to command Hungarian political coverage as opinion polls show his opposition Tisza party broadening its lead over the ruling Fidesz coalition. He has recently made headlines for publicly defending a Tisza lawmaker mocked by government MPs in parliament and for expanding his party's influence in the Budapest Municipal Assembly.
